description: Calculate a time series of one Federal Reserve Board H.15 rate minus another on aligned business dates. Returns both canonical series, component values, percentage-point and basis-point spreads, pagination, provenance, and exact hosted coverage. Use this for '10-year minus 2-year Treasury spread', 'prime minus fed funds', or 'compare 30-year and 5-year yields'. Treasury aliases such as '10y' and '2y' are accepted. Not a forecast or trading signal.

response_format.description: Human-readable markdown or machine-readable JSON. Default markdown.

series_a.description: Exact H.15 series_name, descriptive name, or Treasury alias such as '10-year Treasury', '2y', or '3-month Treasury'.

series_b.description: Exact H.15 series_name, descriptive name, or Treasury alias such as '10-year Treasury', '2y', or '3-month Treasury'.

name: fed_board_h15_rate_spread
